**Position:** PhD Student and Teaching Assistant at UCLouvain

I am a political scientist with a legal background. I study the legal underpinnings of EU Public Finances ('the Financial Regulation of the EU') to better understand the implications for EU integration, insitutional legitimacy, and the marketization of public finances. More information on my PhD research project [here](/projects/political-economy-eu-finances.qmd).
